long_biography.plain_text:
Vail began in law, practising securities work for energy master limited partnerships before moving into operating roles. He led alternative-energy technology at Enron, worked on General Motors’ fuel-cell commercialisation programme, and became president and chief executive of Synthesis Energy Systems, helping take the coal-gasification developer public.

After founding G2X Energy, Vail developed natural-gas-to-methanol projects and led the company until its 2018 sale. He later co-founded and chaired Arbor Renewable Gas, focused on producing low-carbon hydrogen from waste biomass. In 2024 he became chief executive of ION Clean Energy, where he oversees deployment of post-combustion carbon-capture technology, while also serving as an operating partner at Climate Investment.
